simple.meaning: גְּדִי (gᵉdîy) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a young goat (from browsing).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 16 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, Judges, 1 Samuel, and 1 more, beginning at Genesis 27:9. Its contexts include family, flock.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גְּדִי (H1423).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
